title: lophomyrtus × ralphii
intro: Lophomyrtus × ralphii, commonly known as the New Zealand teatree or ralphii, is a hybrid species of plant in the myrtle family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and the management of infections. The therapeutic actions of Lophomyrtus × ralphii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and bioactive constituents of Lophomyrtus × ralphii.
